name: goal-to-tickets
summary: Plan a goal as 1 to 12 linked tickets, check the plan for a dependency cycle, review it, post the tickets in dependency order with the real blocker numbers and choose what happens next. The first option at every point is the default.

points.question: Who checks the plan before the post?

options.label: A review turn corrects the plan
options.summary: One turn compares the drafts with the code and corrects cloving-goal-plan.md. The workflow checks the corrected plan for a cycle again.
options.change: Keep reviewByTurn as checkPlan from goal-to-tickets/review.ts in goal-to-tickets.ts. Keep selection.review as turn in goal-to-tickets/scenarios.ts.

options.label: I read the plan
options.summary: One approval decision shows all titles and dependencies and then the full plan. A denial or an expired decision posts nothing.
options.change: In goal-to-tickets.ts replace reviewByTurn as checkPlan from "./goal-to-tickets/review.ts" with reviewByPerson as checkPlan from "./goal-to-tickets/person.ts". Set selection.review to person in goal-to-tickets/scenarios.ts.

points.question: What happens to the posted tickets?

options.label: Put the ready tickets in the queue
options.summary: Add cloving: ready to each posted ticket that has no blocker. A ticket that needs another ticket of the plan or an existing issue gets no label.
options.change: Keep queueReady as nextTickets from goal-to-tickets/queue.ts in goal-to-tickets.ts. Keep selection.next as queue in goal-to-tickets/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Hand the first ready ticket to develop
options.summary: Start the repository-declared develop workflow on the first posted ticket that has no blocker. If the handoff fails, add cloving: ready to that ticket.
options.change: In goal-to-tickets.ts replace queueReady as nextTickets from "./goal-to-tickets/queue.ts" with handoffFirst as nextTickets from "./goal-to-tickets/develop.ts". Set workflow.handoffs in goal-to-tickets.declaration.json to ["develop"], or to the ID in targetWorkflow of goal-to-tickets/develop.ts. Set selection.next to develop in goal-to-tickets/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Do nothing
options.summary: Leave the posted tickets for a person.
options.change: In goal-to-tickets.ts replace queueReady as nextTickets from "./goal-to-tickets/queue.ts" with leaveTickets as nextTickets from "./goal-to-tickets/leave.ts". Remove label from methods.github in goal-to-tickets.declaration.json. Set selection.next to nothing in goal-to-tickets/scenarios.ts.
